cpp-shop.name: 2.6 Shopping: find similar, price drops
cpp-shop.audience: People choosing something to buy: they compare options and wait for a better price.

promo.en-US: Looking at something to buy? Find similar shows cheaper or newer options with every link checked, and ContextFlow tells you when a price drops.
promo.ru: Присматриваете покупку? «Найти похожее» покажет варианты дешевле или новее и проверит каждую ссылку, а ContextFlow сообщит, когда цена упадёт.

cpp-study.name: 2.6 Study: ask your chats, keep them in order
cpp-study.audience: Students and researchers who read a lot and come back to it later.

promo.en-US: Ask all your chats at once, find one by what it was about, and let suggestions keep answers in the right chat. Ask about PDFs and videos too.
promo.ru: Спросите сразу все свои чаты, найдите нужный по смыслу, а подсказки разложат ответы по чатам. Можно спрашивать и про PDF и видео.

cpp-work.name: 2.6 Work: templates, copies, reminders
cpp-work.audience: Busy people who answer the same messages and fill the same forms every day.

promo.en-US: Templates fill in names and dates from the page, your last copies wait by every field, and a reminder keeps a note in your own words.
promo.ru: Шаблоны сами впишут имя и дату со страницы, последние копии ждут у каждого поля, а напоминание сохранит заметку вашими словами.

cpp-listen.name: 2.6 Listen: pages read aloud
cpp-listen.audience: Commuters and people who would rather listen than read a long page.

promo.en-US: Too long to read? Listen to any page or answer in a natural voice. On iPhone it keeps playing with the screen locked.
promo.ru: Некогда читать? Слушайте любую страницу или ответ естественным голосом. На iPhone звук не прервётся и при заблокированном экране.

cpp-lang.name: 2.6 Other languages: summarize, translate, listen
cpp-lang.audience: People who read pages in a language that isn't their own.

promo.en-US: Reading in another language? Get the page summarized in yours, translate just the part you need, or have it read aloud.
promo.ru: Читаете на другом языке? ContextFlow перескажет страницу по-русски, переведёт только нужный кусок или прочитает вслух.
